shared_elements: ornamented bands (bracelets/armlets, patterned belt or fringed garment)
justification: Both depict a human figure with a conspicuous headdress and decorative banded ornament, but that is about as generic as figural imagery gets. A shows a nearly nude, near-frontal full-length body with raised arm holding an object and a sash across the hips, rendered with fine incised linear detail; B shows only a bearded head and shoulder in strict profile with a tall crown and dense beaded curls, so posture, framing and the conventions for rendering hair and ornament are quite different.
